name: thickness_remaining_below_the_pocket
why: IT IS THE REAL QUESTION: «how much material is left between the bottom of the pocket and the face on the other side?». On a plate 20 thick with a pocket 15 deep, 5 mm remain, and they are the five millimetres that decide whether the part holds or breaks. The survey called it a wall-thickness measurement and rated it risky, because the ray route needs a calibration that nobody knows how to verify: here it is two named faces and a number.
_why_faces_are_chosen_by_area: after the pocket there are TWO faces that look forward -- the top plane and the bottom of the pocket -- and asking for one by direction would be ambiguous. The bottom of the pocket makes 1600 mm2 and the face behind 10,000: they are named by size, which is the only thing that tells them apart.

expect.tolerance_why: 20 of plate minus 15 of pocket; the distance arrives in metres
the number and its points must say the same thing
